senses.gloss: (denom. of שׁבֶט, cmp. σπαθάω fr. σπάθη) to press the weaving rod, to make the web close (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Tela).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:2">Tosef. Sabb. <cite ref="Shabbat 92b">ib. 92ᵇ</cite> … <he>שנים … בכרכר ושׁוֹבְטִין</he> if two persons take hold of the shuttle and press; a. e.
